name: Padel Club Tashkent
tagline: Four courts, rackets to hire and a game you can learn in one evening
niche: Padel club: court hire, coaching, tournaments and a league

seo.title: Padel in Tashkent — Padel Club: courts and coaching
seo.description: Four indoor padel courts, hire from 280,000 UZS for 90 minutes, rackets to rent, beginner coaching and an amateur league. Book on Telegram.
seo.answer: Padel Club Tashkent has four indoor courts at 166 Muqimiy St, open daily 7:00–23:30. A 90-minute court costs 280,000 UZS by day and 380,000 UZS in the evening for four players; racket hire is 30,000 UZS. A beginner trial session is 120,000 UZS per person. Book on Telegram.

listing.description: A site for a padel or tennis club, sports venue or pool. The court is drawn in chalk, a ball flies an arc with its shadow, a weekly booking board sends the chosen slot to Telegram, and numbers sit on a scoreboard.

sections.title: You can play padel from your very first evening
sections.subtitle: Padel is tennis in a glass box: the ball bounces off the walls, it’s two against two and the rules take ten minutes to explain. Bring friends; we’ll lend the rackets.

sections.label: The club
sections.title: A sport people stay around to talk after
sections.text: We opened the club because there was nowhere in Tashkent to play padel all year round. Four indoor courts with panoramic glass and artificial turf, air-conditioning in summer and heating in winter, and a café looking onto the courts. Half our guests come without a partner, and the front desk will find players at your level.

sections.label: Courts and booking
sections.title: Pick a court and a time
sections.intro: Prices are per court for 90 minutes, split between four. Evening rates apply from 17:30 and at weekends.

items.title: Play
items.text: Ninety minutes on court, then tea in the café by the glass.

items.quote: Four of us came and none of us had held a racket. An hour later we were arguing about the score.
items.author: Jahongir

items.quote: I play the Wednesday league. It’s the best way to meet people in town.
items.author: Madina

items.quote: Cool in summer, warm in winter. We play all year round.
items.author: Oleg

items.q: How many players do I need?
items.a: Four, two against two. If you’re fewer, message us and we’ll find partners or add a coach.

items.q: Do I need my own racket?
items.a: No, racket hire is 30,000 UZS a game. You just need trainers with clean soles.
Free up to 12 hours before. After that, we’ll move it to another time within the week.
Same scoring, but a smaller court, an underarm serve and you can play the ball off the glass, so it’s easier to pick up.
Yes, free parking for 40 cars by the entrance.
